against.head: Resistance +1.1% above
against.learn: A price area where sellers stepped in before.
against.text: The nearest ceiling is +1.1% above (0.6 ATR): the Sep 14 high, the 61.8% retracement of the Jul 29–Aug 4 drop and the Oct 5 high: little room before sellers have stepped in before.

against.head: Buying is losing force
against.learn: Price makes a higher high but momentum makes a lower high: buyers are tiring.
against.text: Price made a higher high on Oct 5 while 4 of 7 momentum gauges made a lower high (regular bearish divergence).

CLH.change: A daily close below −5%, under the wave-1 high: wave 4 never overlaps it, proves it wrong. So would heavy selling into the buy zone.

standouts.head: Sitting on stacked support
standouts.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.
standouts.text: Price sits on the May breakout level, the Apr 8 high and the most-traded price of six months: 6 kinds of level at one price.

standouts.head: Wave 4 in its buy zone
standouts.learn: After waves 1 to 3 up, the pullback that usually ends between the 0.382 and 0.5 retracement of wave 3, above the top of wave 1. A daily close up inside the zone is the buy; a close under the wave-1 high ends the count.
standouts.text: Waves 1 to 3 up from Jun 8 to Jul 29 (+21%; wave 3 is 1.8 times wave 1). The pullback has reached the 0.382–0.5 zone of wave 3 (−1% to −2.8%), on lighter volume, with the 50-day average and the May breakout level in the same place. The count is wrong on a daily close under the wave-1 high (−4.6%): wave 4 never overlaps wave 1.

standouts.head: Uptrend on every average
standouts.learn: Higher highs and higher lows, with price above rising averages.
standouts.text: Price is above its rising 50-day and 200-day averages, and the 50-day is above the 200-day.

standouts.head: A hammer at a support area
standouts.learn: A candle with a long lower wick and a close near the high: buyers rejected the lows.
standouts.text: On Oct 16 it dipped and closed near its high, leaving a long lower wick at a support area: buyers rejected the lows.

standouts.head: A possible double bottom
standouts.learn: Two lows at the same level with a peak between; a close above the peak confirms it.
standouts.text: It bottomed twice at the same level (Aug 26 and Oct 1); a close above the peak between them confirms the double bottom.

CLH.take: CLH: it is in an uptrend on every average, and it sits on support at the 0.382–0.5 retracement of wave 3 (Jul 2–Jul 29) and the 50-day average. It is in its wave-4 buy zone, and there is a hammer at a support area. Against it, buying is losing force. This is the kind of setup the desk wants to own.
